title: Nexus CoreConnectInvokeResponse
description: Canonical Connect invoke result envelope: exactly one of result or error is non-null, encoded as a closed success/failure union. Error codes reuse the shared CoreError categories, including not_supported for operations this service does not serve.

success.title: ConnectInvokeSuccess
success.description: Operation succeeded: result carries the payload and error is null.

result.description: Operation result; non-null exactly when error is null.

failure.title: ConnectInvokeFailure
failure.description: Operation refused or failed: error carries the wire envelope and result is null.

error.description: Wire error envelope; non-null exactly when result is null.
